headline: Deep models and epigenome annotation infer regulatory elements from chromatin data
label: Computational Models Of Regulatory Chromatin
summary: Foundation and segmentation models now couple DNA sequence, methylation, histone marks and accessibility to predict regulatory elements and states.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational inference of regulatory structure from chromatin and transcriptional data. ESMM segments 154 IHEC epigenomes using histone marks and DNA methylation, and epigenome-ssm yields 33 pan-cell type state features from 1,698 IHEC epigenomes. Deep sequence models are increasingly conditioned or fine-tuned for regulatory prediction, as in MethylSeqNet and CREP, and H3K18ac is proposed as an enhancer mark. TMO learns signed cell-state-dependent regulatory lags between scATAC and scRNA, and m6A-FORM extends foundation-model pretraining to RNA methylation. A residualization-permutation diagnostic separates predictability-driven from regulation-driven in-silico mutagenesis variance.
